card: This PR updates the qrencode depends package recipe to fetch source archives from GitHub instead of the defunct upstream fukuchi.org host, which returns 404. It downloads the archive under the name qrencode-4.1.1-v2.tar.gz with an updated SHA256 checksum. Renaming the file avoids hash collisions on the bitcoincore.org fallback mirror and in CI caches, resolving the issue that forced the revert of #33494 in #33577.
changed_since_previous: No changes to the patch; this description evaluates the full patch after the previous nopatch stub.
evidence: Prior PR #33577 reverted #33494 because switching to GitHub's tag archive with the original filename broke release branches, noting that renaming the file would be necessary in a follow-up.
problem: The original upstream URL on `fukuchi.org` returns 404, forcing all depends builds that lack local caches to pull from the bitcoincore.org fallback mirror. A previous update (#33494) switched to GitHub tag archives under the original filename, but the archive hash differed from the original tarball and had to be reverted in #33577 because it broke cache verification and fallback downloads for release branches.

risk.why: A corrupt tarball or bad hash would cause depends builds targeting GUI packages with QR code support to fail during download or verification.

summary: Updates the `qrencode` depends recipe to download release archives from GitHub instead of the defunct upstream host. It downloads the archive under a new local filename, `qrencode-4.1.1-v2.tar.gz`, with an updated SHA256 hash to prevent collisions with the original release tarball on fallback mirrors.
